Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:10:1.hebrew: שם בן ארבע אותיות - קריאתו, וכתיבתו, ופירושו — חכמים מוסרין אותו כו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:10:1.english: The four-letter name - Its pronunciation, its writing, and its explanation — the Sages transmit it, etc.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:11:1.hebrew: כתיב זה שמי וכתיב וזה זכרי - מדלא כתיב "שמי וזכרי", משמע שלמדו שני שמות, ואמר לו: זה שמי מיוחד, ובזה השני אני נזכר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:11:1.english: It is written: “This is My name,” and it is written: “And this is My remembrance” - Since it is not written “My name and My remembrance,” it implies that He taught him two names, and said to him: “This is My unique name, and by this second [one] I am remembered.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:1.english: When the uninhibited ones increased - Those who make use of it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:2.hebrew: לצנועים שבכהונה - לברך בו העם במקדש, לאחר עבודת ציבור של תמיד של שחר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:2.english: To discreet [members] of the priesthood - To bless the people with it in the Temple, after the communal service of the morning daily offering.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:3.hebrew: מבליעים אותו בנעימת אחיהם הכהנים - אותן שלא היו בקיאין בו ומברכין בשם בן ארבע אותיות, כשהיו מושכין את קולם בנעימה, היו אלו ממהרים להבליע את השם בן י"ב, ולא היה נשמע לרבים מקול נעימות חביריהם. בנעימת — ביסום קול, שקורין טרוף:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:3.english: Conceal it in the melody of their priestly brothers - Those [priests] who were not knowledgeable in it and would recite the blessing with the four-letter Name — when they would draw out their voice with a melody, these [discreet priests] would hasten to swallow [and obscure] the twelve-letter Name, and it would not be heard by the public over the sound of their colleagues' melodies. “In the melody” [means] a sweetening of the voice, which they call *trope* [chant].

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:4.hebrew: שם - בן שתים עשרה ובן ארבעים ושתים, לא פירשו לנו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:4.english: [The] name: [The] twelve-letter [name] and [the] forty-two-letter [name] — they did not explain [them] to us.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:5.hebrew: אחר אחי אמי - שהיה כהן, ור' טרפון היה כהן. בתוספתא דכתובות (פ"ה): מעשה בר' טרפון שקדש שלש מאות נשים בשני בצורת, כדי להאכילם תרומה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:5.english: After my mother’s brother - For he was a priest, and Rabbi Tarfon was [also] a priest. In the Tosefta of Ketubot (chapter 5): An incident with Rabbi Tarfon, who betrothed three hundred women in years of drought in order to feed them terumah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:12:6.english: To the platform - To recite the Priestly Benediction.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:13:1.hebrew: ואינו מעמיד על מדותיו - לנטור איבה, שמא ישתמש בו להנקם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:13:1.english: And does not insist upon his rights - [That is, not] to harbor enmity, lest he use [the Name] to take revenge.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:14:1.hebrew: עד שיודע לך - במשפחה שאתה בא ליבדק בה, במה נפסלה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:14:1.english: Until it becomes known to you - Regarding a family that you come to examine, in what way it was disqualified.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:14:2.hebrew: עד שיודע לך במה נכשרה - צריך אתה לבדוק אחר המשפחה, כמו שאמרה משנתינו (לקמן קידושין דף עו.): ארבע אמהות שהן שמנה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:14:2.english: Until it becomes known to you in what way it was validated - You must investigate the family, as our Mishnah stated (below, Kiddushin 76a): “Four mothers, which are eight.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:1:1.english: Purifies the tribes - Clarifies their lineage.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:2:1.hebrew: כסף מטהר ממזרים - המטומעים בישראל מחמת ממונם, והוא גורם להם שיטהרו, שלעתיד לבא אין הקב"ה מבדילם, מאחר שנדבקו בהם משפחות ישראל הרבה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:2:1.english: Money purifies mamzerim - Those who are assimilated into Israel on account of their wealth, and this causes them to be purified, for in the future to come the Holy One, Blessed be He, will not separate them, since many Jewish families have become attached to them.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:2:2.hebrew: שנאמר וישב מצרף ומטהר כסף - אותם שנטמעו מחמת עשרם. וסיפיה דקרא: ״והיו לה' מגישי מנחה בצדקה״ — צדקתו של הקב"ה היא שאינו מבדילם, אלא הואיל שנטמעו נטמעו. ורבי יהושע בן לוי סבירא ליה: האי ״מטהר״ לאו מבדיל פסוליהן קאמר, אלא מטהרם ומכשירם כולם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:2:2.english: As it is stated: “And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver” - [This refers to] those who became assimilated on account of their wealth. And the end of the verse [states]: “And they shall offer to the Lord offerings in righteousness” — it is the righteousness of the Holy One, Blessed be He, that He does not separate them, but rather, since they have become assimilated, they remain assimilated. And Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi maintains [that] this [term] “purifies” does not mean separating out their disqualified [members], but rather He purifies them and renders all of them fit.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:1.hebrew: עיסה - כעיסה שהיא מעורבת. ובשם ר' משה מרומא"ט (רומ"א: רומא (בירת איטליה)) שמעתי: עיסה — כפסולת ענבים שנסחט משקה שלהם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:1.english: Dough - Like dough, which is mixed. And in the name of Rabbi Moshe of Rome (Rom'a: Rome, the capital of Italy), I heard: isah [is] like the refuse of grapes whose juice has been pressed out.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:2.hebrew: בקשו לעשות בבל עיסה - להחזיק משפחות ארץ ישראל מיוחסות, ולבדוק אחר משפחות בבל כל הבאים לישא משם אשה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:2.english: They sought to establish Babylonia as muddled - To presume the families of Eretz Yisrael to be of [pure] lineage, and to investigate the families of Babylonia [for] all who come to marry a woman from there.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:3.hebrew: אמר להם אין שחיטה לעוף - דבר שהוא תימה להם, ולא גלה להם טעמו, כדי שיהו טרודים בסברא הראשונה ולא יחזרו אחר טעם השניה, עד שיפטר מהם. וטעם דאין שחיטה לעוף מן התורה — בשחיטת חולין (דף כז:) יליף מושפך את דמו, בשפיכה בעלמא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:3.english: He said to them: Slaughter of a bird is not [obligatory] - [This was] a matter that was astonishing to them, and he did not reveal its reason to them, so that they would be preoccupied with the first reasoning and would not pursue the reason for the second until he had departed from them. And the reason that slaughter of a bird is not [obligatory] by Torah law: in [tractate] Sheḥitat Ḥullin (page 27b), [the Gemara] derives [it] from “and he shall pour out its blood” — mere pouring [is sufficient].

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:4.hebrew: קוצים אתם משימים בין עיני - משום דרבי ממשפחת בבל היה, מבני בניו של הלל, שעלה וקיבל נשיאותו של בני בתירא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:4.english: Are you placing thorns between my eyes? - Because Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] was from a Babylonian family, [being] of the descendants of Hillel, who ascended and received the presidency from the sons of Beteira.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:3:5.english: Rabbi Ḥanina will engage with you - To respond to you.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:5:1.hebrew: טלוני בעריסה ורוצו - שלא יפשפשו אחר דבריו, ויהא צריך לגלות משפחות. והוא היה זקן, ולא היה יכול לרוץ:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:5:1.english: Pick me up on a stretcher and run - So that they would not scrutinize his words and he would have to reveal [flawed] families; and he was old and could not run.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:5:2.hebrew: אמר להם אין שחיטה לעוף - דבר שהוא תימה להם, ולא גלה להם טעמו, כדי שיהו טרודים בסברא הראשונה, ולא יחזרו אחר טעם השניה עד שיפטר מהם. וטעם דאין שחיטה לעוף מן התורה — בשחיטת חולין (דף כז:) יליף מושפך את דמו: בשפיכה בעלמא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:5:2.english: He said to them: Slaughter of a bird is not [obligatory by Torah law] - [This was] a matter that was astonishing to them, and he did not reveal to them its reasoning, so that they would be preoccupied with the first line of reasoning and would not pursue the reasoning of the second until he had departed from them. And the reasoning that slaughter of a bird is not [required] by Torah law — in [Tractate] Shechitat Chullin (daf 27b), it derives [this] from "and he shall pour out its blood": by mere pouring out.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:6:1.hebrew: ישבו ובדקו - במשפחות א"י, לברר את דבריו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:6:1.english: They sat and examined - Among the families of Eretz Yisrael, to verify his statement.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:6:2.hebrew: כיון שהגיעו לסכנה - לפסול משפחות אנשי זרוע שיהרגום — פירשו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:6:2.english: Once they reached danger - [That is,] to disqualify families of violent men who would kill them — they withdrew.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:7:1.english: The Sanctuary - [This is] an oath by the Sanctuary of the Omnipresent.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:7:2.english: It is in our hands - To reveal the disqualification of the families of the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:1.hebrew: תנינא - דכל משפחה שנטמעה נטמעה, דאין להפרישה ולהרחיקה ולברר ספק מטמעיהם — מי נטמע, מי לא נטמע — אלא יניחום. והם ספק, והם כשרים לעתיד לבא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:1.english: We have learned - That any family that has become assimilated has become assimilated; that one is not to separate it and distance it, nor clarify the doubt of their assimilation — who became assimilated [and] who did not become assimilated — but rather they should leave them [alone]. And [though] they are [of] doubtful [status], they are fit for the future to come.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:2.english: Beit HaTzerifa - The name of the family.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:3.english: Ben Tziyon - A prominent person and a man of force.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:4.english: Distanced it - He proclaimed that they are disqualified.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:5.hebrew: אליהו בא - לעתיד לבא, דכתיב (מלאכי ג) והשיב לב אבות על בנים — זה מבני בניו של זה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:5.english: Elijah comes - In the future to come, as it is written (Malachi 3): "And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children" — [to clarify that] this [person] is of the descendants of that [person].

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:6.english: [Those] that are known - For everyone presumes them to be disqualified [families] that were drawn near by force.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:7.hebrew: אבל משפחה שנטמעה - מחמת שלא נודע פסולה, נטמעה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:8:7.english: But a family that has become assimilated - Because its disqualification was not known, it has become assimilated.

Rashi on Kiddushin 71a:9:1.english: There was another - There was another family, aside from that [one] which Ben Tziyon drew near.
